verdict.rationale: Benchmark's API page says developers can create, rename, duplicate, merge, and delete lists from another system. It also documents searching contacts by list, which reads back list membership programmatically. missing for 10: API support for segments and tags, explicit list-membership endpoints or reference docs (the OpenAPI probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and update segments, tags, or lists programmatically and read back exactly who is in them
